description: Send a Nepternship member an introduction request, with an optional note of up to 200 characters, for the person they can introduce the user to (for example an analyst at JPMorgan or an engineer at Google). Use this when the user wants an intro or referral from a member returned by search_members, browse_directory or get_member, or taps Request intro on the member card. Check with the user whether they want to add a note before calling. Needs a Nepternship account: without one, the result explains the next step (a few join questions for new members, then connecting the account). Pass join_code when sign_up returned one. Returns the request status, or a clear reason when the free limit is reached or a request already exists.

existing_member.description: True when the user says they already have a Nepternship account and is not connected yet

join_code.description: The join_code from sign_up, when a new member saved their join answers in this conversation

name: send_intro_request
title: Request a warm introduction
